note: 2026 Sky Store Premiere 1–30 lineup from 30 October screenshot. Detailed plot summaries, cast, directors and genre; genre classifications are descriptive and may be approximate for unreleased films. One all-day listing per channel.

movie.title: Heart of the Beast
movie.description: After a devastating plane crash, Special Forces veteran James Belmont and his combat dog Odin are stranded in the remote Alaskan wilderness. Facing extreme weather, dwindling supplies and a dangerous journey through unforgiving terrain, the pair must rely on their training and enduring bond to survive.
movie.cast: Brad Pitt (James Belmont), J.K. Simmons (Watkins), Anna Lambe

movie.title: Primetime
movie.description: In 2006, television host Chris Hansen sets out to make history with an ambitious undercover operation for To Catch a Predator. As the stakes rise and the operation goes disastrously wrong, his pursuit of ratings and fame becomes a troubling examination of sensationalism, ambition and the limits of televised justice.
movie.cast: Robert Pattinson (Chris Hansen), Skyler Gisondo (Dan Plumb), Merritt Wever (Andie Bender), Phoebe Bridgers (Del), Matthew Maher (Xavier Von Erck)

movie.title: Sense and Sensibility
movie.description: After their family fortunes change, sisters Elinor and Marianne Dashwood must navigate financial insecurity, social expectations and the uncertain prospect of marriage. Elinor tries to conceal her feelings behind composure and good judgment, while Marianne follows her heart with passionate openness. As each faces disappointment and unexpected possibilities, the sisters discover the value of balancing reason with emotion in this new adaptation of Jane Austen's beloved novel.
movie.cast: Daisy Edgar-Jones, Esmé Creed-Miles, Caitríona Balfe, Frank Dillane, George MacKay, Fiona Shaw

movie.title: Verity
movie.description: Struggling writer Lowen Ashleigh accepts a lucrative assignment to finish the books of bestselling author Verity Crawford, who can no longer complete her work. Staying at the isolated Crawford family estate, Lowen grows close to Verity's husband Jeremy but discovers a disturbing manuscript that appears to reveal terrible family secrets. As attraction, suspicion and fear intensify, Lowen struggles to distinguish truth from fiction and to understand whether the danger surrounding her is real or carefully orchestrated.
movie.cast: Anne Hathaway, Dakota Johnson, Josh Hartnett, Ismael Cruz Córdova, Brady Wagner

movie.title: Forgotten Island
movie.description: Lifelong best friends Jo and Raissa are preparing to take different paths after high school when a mysterious portal transports them to Nakali, a fantastical island inhabited by creatures from Filipino mythology. With the help of an unlikely weredog companion named Raww, they face extraordinary friends and enemies, including the terrifying Manananggal. But escaping the island comes at a heartbreaking price: the memories of their friendship. The pair must find another way home before they forget each other forever.
movie.cast: H.E.R., Liza Soberano, Dave Franco, Jenny Slate, Manny Jacinto, Dolly de Leon, Jo Koy, Ronny Chieng, Lea Salonga

movie.title: Resident Evil
movie.description: Medical courier Bryan becomes trapped in a nightmarish chain of events as a seemingly ordinary delivery descends into chaos. Forced to confront horrifying dangers, he fights to survive in this new standalone interpretation of the Resident Evil universe.
movie.cast: Austin Abrams (Bryan), Zach Cherry, Kali Reis, Paul Walter Hauser

movie.title: Model Citizen
movie.description: Former police officer Steven Bay, struggling with amnesia and a fragmented past, seeks treatment while working on a secluded farm. Suspicious behavior, hostile encounters and unsettling surveillance convince him that his surroundings conceal something sinister. As his instincts return, he sets out to uncover the truth about his identity and the forces manipulating his life.
movie.cast: Aaron Eckhart (Steven Bay), Emmanuelle Chriqui (Gretchen Lowe), Paul Braunstein (Bud O'Neil), David Hewlett (Dr. Harris)

movie.title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
movie.description: After his wife dies, Latif, a devoutly religious contract killer and father, struggles to protect his children while navigating grief, faith and the consequences of his violent profession. As dangerous figures close in across Houston, he faces impossible choices about fatherhood, survival and the life he has built.
movie.cast: Mahershala Ali (Latif), John Cho (Pastor Hwan), Giancarlo Esposito (Abdul Malik), Abubakr Ali (Hatty), Tiffany Boone, Tramell Tillman

movie.title: Runner
movie.description: A successful lawyer races across London after her son is abducted. Following increasingly cryptic orders from an unknown caller, she must make urgent decisions under pressure while trying to uncover who is controlling the ordeal.
movie.cast: Gal Gadot

movie.title: The Uprising
movie.description: In plague-ravaged medieval England, a peasant's defiance of King Richard II ignites a rebellion against royal tyranny. As the revolt spreads, an ordinary man becomes an unexpected symbol of resistance in a struggle for justice.
movie.cast: Andrew Garfield

movie.title: Spa Weekend
movie.description: Three friends hope to relax and reconnect during a luxurious spa getaway. Their plans unravel when a notoriously chaotic fourth friend joins them, transforming the peaceful weekend into a series of unpredictable mishaps.
movie.cast: Leslie Mann, Isla Fisher, Michelle Buteau, Anna Faris

movie.title: Matchbox: The Movie
movie.description: A group of childhood friends reunites after years apart, only to become entangled in a dangerous international conspiracy. Their reunion turns into a fast-moving adventure as they try to outwit their pursuers and prevent a threat with worldwide consequences.
movie.cast: John Cena, Jessica Biel, Arturo Castro

movie.title: The Florist
movie.description: A quiet horticulturist leads a secret double life as a professional assassin. When he befriends someone who has witnessed police corruption, his carefully concealed identity and the safety of those around him are placed at risk.
movie.cast: Dennis Quaid, Jean Reno, Sky Katz

movie.title: The Incomer
movie.description: On an isolated Scottish island, siblings Isla and Sandy live according to their own unusual customs, hunting birds and speaking of mythical beings. Their secluded existence is disrupted when an awkward government official arrives with orders to relocate them.
movie.cast: Domhnall Gleeson, Gayle Rankin, Grant O'Rourke

movie.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
movie.description: Four years after everyone forgot Peter Parker, he lives alone and devotes himself entirely to protecting New York as Spider-Man. As a troubling pattern of crimes emerges, the pressure of his double life brings unexpected changes and draws him toward a formidable new adversary.
movie.cast: Tom Holland, Zendaya, Sadie Sink, Jacob Batalon, Jon Bernthal, Mark Ruffalo

movie.title: Tenzing
movie.description: The remarkable true story of Tenzing Norgay, whose life and determination led him to the summit of Mount Everest. Alongside Edmund Hillary, he attempts a historic ascent while confronting the physical danger and human cost of high-altitude exploration.
movie.cast: Genden Phuntsok, Tom Hiddleston, Willem Dafoe, Caitríona Balfe

movie.title: The End of Oak Street
movie.description: A mysterious cosmic event transports the Platt family's ordinary suburban neighborhood to an unknown and hostile place. Surrounded by extraordinary dangers, the family must set aside its internal tensions and work together to find a way to survive.
movie.cast: Anne Hathaway, Ewan McGregor, Maisy Stella, Christian Convery

movie.title: Supergirl
movie.description: Kara Zor-El embarks on an interstellar journey after a violent encounter strikes close to home. Accompanied by an unlikely ally, she pursues justice and revenge across dangerous worlds while confronting the consequences of her past.
movie.cast: Milly Alcock, Matthias Schoenaerts, Eve Ridley, David Krumholtz, Jason Momoa

movie.title: The Dog Stars
movie.description: In a world devastated by a catastrophic pandemic, Hig, a pilot living at a remote airfield, has built a guarded existence alongside Bangley, a tough military survivalist. Their fragile safety is disrupted when a mysterious radio transmission offers the possibility of other survivors. Driven by grief, curiosity and the hope of human connection, Hig risks everything to fly beyond the boundaries of his isolated refuge, confronting dangers that test his instinct for survival and his faith in humanity.
movie.cast: Jacob Elordi, Josh Brolin, Margaret Qualley, Guy Pearce, Benedict Wong, Allison Janney

movie.title: The Weight
movie.description: In 1933 Oregon, Samuel Murphy is separated from his daughter and sent to a brutal work camp. Offered an early release in exchange for smuggling gold through treacherous wilderness, he faces betrayal and danger on a desperate journey home.
movie.cast: Ethan Hawke, Russell Crowe, Julia Jones, Austin Amelio, Avi Nash

movie.title: The Odyssey
movie.description: After the fall of Troy, Odysseus begins an epic voyage home to Ithaca and his waiting family. His journey takes him through seas ruled by gods and monsters, where encounters with a Cyclops, enchantresses and deadly temptations test his ingenuity and endurance.
movie.cast: Matt Damon, Tom Holland, Anne Hathaway, Robert Pattinson, Lupita Nyong'o, Zendaya, Charlize Theron

movie.title: Ali G: Who Iz I?
movie.description: After discovering that his longtime girlfriend Julie is eight months pregnant, Ali G heads to America in a chaotic bid to revive his celebrity career and earn money for his growing family. His outrageous encounters with real people turn the journey into a provocative mockumentary about fame, identity and impending fatherhood.
movie.cast: Sacha Baron Cohen (Ali G), Morgana Robinson (Julie), Alpha Miknas (Manu), Clive Russell (Malcolm 'Rocky' Atkins)

movie.title: Insidious: Out of the Further
movie.description: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in her childhood home, discovers she can enter the Further, a terrifying realm inhabited by lost souls and malevolent entities. But her extraordinary ability has a dangerous consequence: she can bring its inhabitants back into the living world. As sinister forces target her family, Gemma must confront the nightmare she has unleashed.
movie.cast: Amelia Eve (Gemma Hall), Island Austin (Maya Hall), Lin Shaye (Elise Rainier), Brandon Perea, Maisie Richardson-Sellers, Sam Spruell

movie.title: Fall 2: Deadpoint
movie.description: Still mourning her sister Shiloh, Jax joins her sister's daring friend Luce for a dangerous climb on Thailand's Mount Kwan. A rockslide leaves the women stranded high above the ground on a narrow walkway, forcing Jax to confront grief and fear as they struggle to survive.
movie.cast: Harriet Slater, Arsema Thomas

movie.title: The Love Hypothesis
movie.description: Graduate researcher Olive Smith impulsively kisses the notoriously intimidating Dr. Adam Carlsen to convince a friend she has moved on. The two agree to pretend they are dating, but their carefully calculated arrangement becomes complicated when real feelings begin to develop.
movie.cast: Lili Reinhart, Tom Bateman, Rachel Marsh

movie.title: The Fix
movie.description: After the war in Afghanistan, a group of disillusioned former CIA operatives heads to Tehran in pursuit of a lucrative score. Their dangerous plan unfolds amid divided loyalties and the risks of operating in hostile territory.
movie.cast: Liam Neeson, Zachary Levi

movie.title: Onslaught
movie.description: A unit of genetically enhanced soldiers breaks free in the desert, turning an isolated landscape into a deadly hunting ground. An Army sniper fights to protect her young daughter while facing attackers whose strength and training make escape almost impossible.
movie.cast: Adria Arjona, Dan Stevens, Eric Wareheim

movie.title: By Any Means
movie.description: In 1960s Mississippi, a young FBI agent investigating the murders of civil rights leaders joins forces with notorious Mafia hitman Greg Scarpa. Their unlikely alliance blurs the boundary between justice and vengeance.
movie.cast: Yahya Abdul-Mateen II, Mark Wahlberg, Nicole Beharie, Josh Lucas, Giancarlo Esposito

movie.title: Practical Magic 2
movie.description: Generations of women in a family of witches are still haunted by a curse that has doomed their romantic relationships for centuries. To finally break its hold, they must confront painful family secrets and decide what they are prepared to sacrifice for one another.
movie.cast: Sandra Bullock, Nicole Kidman, Joey King, Lee Pace, Maisie Williams

movie.title: Tony
movie.description: At nineteen, Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and unexpectedly enters the hectic world of a professional restaurant kitchen. The friendships, pressure and exhilaration of his first culinary experiences set him on a path that will change his life.
movie.cast: Dominic Sessa, Antonio Banderas, Emilia Jones
